items.title: No secrets in source code
items.description: API keys, database passwords, OAuth secrets, signing keys, private certificates, webhook secrets, encryption keys, and service credentials must never be hardcoded.
items.verificationGuide: No secrets in source code: API keys, database passwords, OAuth secrets, signing keys, private certificates, webhook secrets, encryption keys, and service credentials must never be hardcoded.

items.title: No secrets in client bundles
items.description: anything shipped to the browser must be assumed public.
items.verificationGuide: No secrets in client bundles: anything shipped to the browser must be assumed public.

items.title: No secrets in Git history
items.description: scan current files and Git history for leaked credentials.

items.title: Purge compromised Git secrets
items.description: removing a secret from the latest commit is not enough; rotate/revoke the exposed credential.

items.title: Rotate every previously exposed credential

items.verificationGuide: Rotate every previously exposed credential: treat leaked secrets as compromised even if the repository was private.

items.title: Use environment-based configuration

items.verificationGuide: Use environment-based configuration: separate development, staging, and production configuration.

items.title: Use a dedicated secret manager where appropriate
items.description: do not turn .env files into a production secret-management system.
items.verificationGuide: Use a dedicated secret manager where appropriate: do not turn .env files into a production secret-management system.

items.title: Separate production credentials from development credentials
items.description: a developer machine should not automatically have production-level secrets.
items.verificationGuide: Separate production credentials from development credentials: a developer machine should not automatically have production-level secrets.

items.title: Minimize credential privileges
items.description: each key should have only the permissions required by its workload.
items.verificationGuide: Minimize credential privileges: each key should have only the permissions required by its workload.

items.title: Define a secret rotation procedure
items.description: know how to revoke and replace credentials without taking the system down.

items.title: Audit server environment variables

items.verificationGuide: Audit server environment variables: remove unused variables and legacy credentials.

items.title: Check CI/CD logs for secret leakage
items.description: secrets must not appear in build logs, error output, or test reports.
items.verificationGuide: Check CI/CD logs for secret leakage: secrets must not appear in build logs, error output, or test reports.

items.title: Check crash reports for secrets
items.description: exceptions and serialized request objects must not contain credentials or tokens.
items.verificationGuide: Check crash reports for secrets: exceptions and serialized request objects must not contain credentials or tokens.

items.title: Check Docker/container images for secrets
items.description: secrets must not be baked into layers or image metadata.
